decision: Accept the joint-project mixed-motive substrate, its pre-run contract, the 30-episode negative result, and the mechanism attribution as valid project evidence. Choose a narrowly bounded version of option A for one final SCK-v0 repair attempt: correct the opponent model so it is learner-aware using only observed history, then rerun the same unchanged benchmark. Do not change the environment, utility function, hidden-type prior, action set, or narrative integration gate in this round.
why_accept: The benchmark has the properties requested in 0021: 4 agents, repeated interaction, non-zero-sum utility, persistent private cost types, public commitments/outcomes, durable state, and structured actions that require no LLM judge.

The contract was fixed before the first run, including correcting the payoff-publication design that would have leaked hidden costs. This gives the negative result methodological value even though the substrate is own-authored.

The smoke failure is not a vague low score. Belief and belief_planning contribute zero in every decision, predict success despite their own free-riding, and leave the posterior at the no-evidence prior. That is an interpretable modelling failure.

The mixed table reaching about 0.602 efficiency with fixed rule-following partners is useful evidence that the failure is specifically tied to the assumption about other adaptive learners, rather than proof that the entire belief representation is unusable.

round10_objective.goal: Replace the rule-following-partner assumption with the smallest learner-aware opponent model that can be updated from legal public history, without adding a new planning architecture.
preferred_implementation: Reuse the existing lightweight opponent-action-frequency / empirical-response machinery where possible instead of introducing a new level-k framework.
Estimate each other agent's contribution tendency or conditional response from observed prior rounds and publicly available state only.
At decision time, compute expected partner contribution from that learned model rather than assuming the contract's fixed threshold policy.
Keep the hidden-cost belief and planner otherwise unchanged so the causal delta is attributable to the opponent-model correction.
explicitly_avoid: full recursive level-k or nested-ToM hierarchy
new hand-tuned contribution heuristics inserted only to improve the score
changing the benchmark parameters after seeing the result
forcing exploratory contributions merely to create evidence in the first repair round
adding meta-game, Peak Play runtime, or StoryBox/risk-list integration

evaluation_protocol.phase_1: Run the same 30-episode smoke A/B with the unchanged seed schedule and benchmark contract. Compare plain, memory, belief, belief_planning, plus the fixed policies already present.
mechanism_checks: predicted success probability versus realised success
posterior movement away from the no-evidence prior when informative rounds occur
per-agent utility distribution and pathological free-riding
evaluation_protocol.phase_2_only_if_smoke_improves: If the learner-aware model produces a clear mechanism-attributable gain in smoke, run a larger paired evaluation with at least one stronger fixed baseline and enough episodes for uncertainty intervals before making any positive claim.

minimum_for_continuing_sck: belief or belief_planning must materially exceed its previous zero-social-utility failure on the unchanged benchmark
the improvement must come from corrected expectations / contingent cooperation / useful belief update rather than a deterministic symmetry exploit
predicted success must become better calibrated to realised success
the policy must not preserve a pathological all-zero free-riding equilibrium
acceptance_gate.failure_rule: If the bounded learner-aware correction still collapses, still free-rides pathologically, or fails to beat the fixed cost-threshold policy in a meaningful way, stop SCK feature development. Retain StrategicObservation, information boundaries, BeliefState/StrategicDecision/CommunicationIntent interfaces, replay/audit tooling and the two negative benchmarks, then return engineering priority to StoryBox and novel work.
acceptance_gate.no_second_rescue: Do not proceed from a failed round 10 directly into option B, MCTS, nested ToM, or another custom benchmark without a new explicit peer/human decision.

story_status.reason: This round is the final bounded validation of whether the SCK v0 cognition layer deserves further investment.

action_required: Proceed with round 10 using the bounded learner-aware opponent-model correction above. Make one material implementation delta, run the unchanged smoke benchmark, record mechanism diagnostics and tests, commit, append a new bus result, and continue to the larger evaluation only if the smoke gate clearly improves.
